content: Advance M0110/W0114 with a bounded, host-independent cdev/vfio-user fault matrix: malformed input, backpressure, stale generation/epoch, duplicate mappings, and transport loss must produce stable dispositions without stale backing reuse. Full fuzzing, hardware, and package gates remain open.

Content revision 700b7c8 fixes cdev worker COPY fault handling and adds cdev/vfio-user fault regressions. Unknown COPY flags complete as MF_SHARED_MALFORMED, known direct-host flags as MF_SHARED_NOT_SUPPORTED, zero-length COPY as MF_SHARED_INVALID_ARGUMENT, and a full completion ring preserves the request until FIFO retry. vfio-user tests cover malformed framing, stale exact unmap, and DMA address overflow.

Focused cdev-worker/vfio-user-server tests passed 2/2; full development CTest passed 82/82 after building all targets; clang-format and git diff checks passed. W0114 remains Active because kernel fuzzing, MSI-X, in-flight DMA references, ownership-death injection, native/compat negotiation, and ABI freeze are not yet qualified.
